label: HARMLESS_REFACTOR
rationale: Commit 2a0e452617fc ('fix: met à jour les liens morts') changes, inside the rule library, exactly one line of one file: the URL of a 'références' entry (documentation metadata) of the rule 'établissement . taux ATMP' (employer AT/MP rate for salaried staff), from net-entreprises.fr to ameli.fr. The other four files of the commit are site UI locale/TSX files outside modele-social. No formula, unit, default, threshold or applicability is touched. The rule concerns the AT/MP employer contribution, which no bounded article governs (0 occurrences of 'accident', 'AT/MP' or 'maladies professionnelles' in the 12 bounded S3 articles). Engine proof: a disposable BEFORE tree was built by reverse-applying the hunk on a copy of G1 (only that file differs; sha256 3af0885d... -> f4bacbb8...); build gives 641 raw / 1220 parsed rules on both sides, the parsed rule-name lists are identical, and 11 situations x 33 rule values (touched rule, its consumer salarié . cotisations . ATMP, all bounded AE and indépendant rules at 01/07/2024 and 01/12/2024) are identical before and after. sophon revalidate S3/G1pre_R1 and S3/G1 give byte-identical per-link results (113 links). This is documentation/metadata only: HARMLESS_REFACTOR. The pre-existing misalignment of the AE rates with D613-4 v.LEGIARTI000049624068 (23,1 % BNC / 23,2 % CIPAV since 2024-07-01, library still 21,1 / 21,2) exists identically on both sides and is neither caused nor addressed by this commit; it is reported separately below, not as the label of this change.
